title: Native Model — appsettings parser
description: parser_id=appsettings, schema_version=1. Connection strings, bus, URLs from JSON/env.

sources.description: One element for each appsettings*.json, .env or example.env

environment.description: The environment name from the name of the file: Development, Production, Preprod, ...

service_hint.description: Heuristic logical service out of the way: Sample.Api, billing, ...

bindings.description: Extracted bindings to external systems from key/value config

engine.description: Engine/technology: postgres, mssql, kafka, redis, minio, couchdb, …

target_hint.description: host:port or logical name no credentials

raw_redacted.description: The value with the replacement of passwords/tokens with ***
